p.x:
I no longer question *if* people are going to choose to upload. I've all but realized there will be waves of takers after the first k-pop idol or e-girl influencer reaches out to their adoring fans from beyond (beside?) the grave.

Now my questions have moved to the spirit; I wonder about the source of all things and if we can retain access to it when we abandon our bodies. 

"Abandon our bodies" - it almost feels like a type-error tragedy, to me, like the sort of thing I'd laugh at before reminding you that your brain extends down to your feet. But it's going to happen.

Despite my best efforts, full brain emulation never seems to consider the neurons in the heart. And what about full soul emulation? Maybe that's a type error, too, or maybe your soul is something that emerges from the pattern of your mind. I'm open to the possibilities - with motivated reasoning, without a doubt. There are few things I want more than to live purely in the Astral - so long as I can take my darling wife with me. So long as it's *actually her*.

But - there's a reason we consider people who live purely in the mind to be unhealthy. Perhaps *we* need bodies to be *us*. Maybe that's fine, and the untethered souls will just be something other than human - beyond good and evil, or just beyond.

We're getting closer to the undeniable part of the exponential. Everyone will be skeptical, even as their micropropulsion wings are being grafted to their spinal column. Even as they make the decision to grow a brainless clone upon needing a new liver. Even when they decide that it's better to upload Grandma into afterspace and figure out the philosophy later rather than risk losing her forever.

It's all coming at us faster than we can suppose. Have you made a plan, yet? Drawn some lines in the sand? Make sure to talk to your parents about the superworms and voice-cloning, before they lose it all to some OSS-powered hacker in Uzbekistan. Make sure to find God once and for all so you don't lose Him forever in the chaos to come.

More important than finding out where you stand is finding out who you stand with. Nothing about tomorrow will matter if you can't bring your people from today.
